# HEIC/HEIF decoder

Unmodified heic-to 1.6.7 IIFE distribution. Loaded locally only when native decoding of a HEIC/HEIF photo fails; no photo is sent for conversion.

- License: LGPL-3.0, see heic-to-LICENSE.txt and GPL-3.0.txt.
- Upstream source and build instructions: https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to/tree/v1.6.7
- Distribution/source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/heic-to/-/heic-to-1.6.7.tgz
- Underlying libheif source: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/tree/v1.23.7
- libde265 source: https://github.com/strukturag/libde265/tree/v1.0.16

This library is a separate, replaceable script. RECOVERY44 source and the standalone builder do not modify its implementation.
